item.title: IU beats Ohio State to win Big Ten Championship
item.description: IU defeated Ohio State 13-10 to win the Big Ten Championship, with Fernando Mendoza connecting with Elijah Sarratt for a 17 yard touchdown in the third quarter to give the Hoosiers the lead.

item.title: ‘You’re bound to the caucus’: Republican senator says majority support redistricting Indiana
item.description: Indiana State Senator R. Michael Young (R-Indianapolis) wants to see Republican colleagues support the House-approved redistricting bill, which would create Republican majorities in all nine of Indiana's congressional districts.

item.title: Cloudy bitter night with midweek rain and snow | Dec. 7, 2025
item.description: Central Indiana is expecting a cold and wintry week with temperatures ranging from the upper teens to low 40s, and light snow showers possible throughout the week.

item.title: Daniel Jones’ Achilles injury ‘could be season-ending’
item.description: Colts quarterback Daniel Jones suffered an Achilles injury in the first quarter of the game against the Jaguars, which could be season-ending, and was replaced by Riley Leonard.

item.title: Notre Dame will skip bowl game after being left out of College Football Playoff
item.description: Notre Dame has decided to not participate in a bowl game after being left out of the College Football Playoff.

item.title: Colts fall to the Jaguars in Jacksonville
item.description: The Colts lost to the Jaguars 36-19 in Jacksonville, with Daniel Jones suffering an Achilles injury in the first quarter.
